Kelowna, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - F4 Uranium Corp. (TSXV: FFU) ("F4" or the "Company") is pleased to announce a non-brokered private placement (the "Offering") consisting of up to 17,647,059 common shares of the Company (each, a "FT Share") that shall qualify as "flow-through shares" within the meaning of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the "Tax Act") at a price of C$0.085 per FT Share for gross proceeds of up to approximately C$1,500,000. Red Cloud Securities Inc. will act as a finder for the Company in respect of the Offering on a best-efforts basis.

The Company intends to use the proceeds of the Offering to incur eligible "Canadian exploration expenses" that qualify as "flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures" as such terms are defined in the Tax Act, and to incur "eligible flow-through mining expenditures" pursuant to The Mineral Exploration Tax Credit Regulations, 2014 (Saskatchewan) (collectively, the "Qualifying Expenditures") related to the Company's uranium projects in the Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, on or before December 31, 2027. All Qualifying Expenditures will be renounced in favour of the subscribers of the FT Shares effective December 31, 2026.

The Offering is scheduled to close on or about December 18, 2026 (the "Closing Date"), or such other date as determined by the Company. Completion of the Offering is subject to certain conditions, including but not limited to, the receipt of all necessary approvals, including the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSX-V"). The FT Shares to be issued under the Offering will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the closing date of the Offering.

It is anticipated that certain directors, officers and other insiders of the Company may acquire FT Shares under the Offering. Such participation will be considered to be "related party transactions" within the meaning of TSX-V Policy 5.9 (the "Policy") and Multilateral Instrument 61-101-Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101") adopted in the Policy. The Company intends to rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 in respect of related party participation in the Offering as neither the fair market value (as determined under MI 61-101) of the subject matter of, nor the fair market value of the consideration for, the transaction, insofar as it involves interested parties, is expected to exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization (as determined under MI 61-101).

This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy nor shall there be any sale of any of the securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful, including any of the securities in the United States of America. The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "1933 Act") or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to, or for account or benefit of, U.S. Persons (as defined in Regulation S under the 1933 Act) unless registered under the 1933 Act and applicable state securities laws, or an exemption from such registration requirements is available.

About F4 Uranium Corp.:

F4 Uranium is a Canadian uranium exploration company focused on the Athabasca Basin in northern Saskatchewan, led by the management and exploration team behind multiple uranium discoveries in the Basin, including most recently Patterson Lake North and Broach Lake. The project portfolio comprises 16 wholly owned properties totaling approximately 157,000 hectares, several of which sit near established uranium deposits including Paladin's Triple R, NexGen Energy's Arrow and IsoEnergy's Hurricane. The assets were spun out of F3 Uranium in 2024. F4's exploration program is split between the west and east sides of the Athabasca Basin, with the Company operating as both an explorer and project generator providing investors early-stage exposure to the Basin.

SINGAPORE, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ Ticker: HBNB) (“Hotel101” or “Hotel101 Global”), a leading asset-light, prop-tech hospitality platform pioneering a globally standardized “condotel” business model, listed on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange and a subsidiary of Philippine-listed DoubleDragon Corporation (PSE Ticker: DD), announces the signing of definitive binding agreements for the joint venture development of an approx. 625-room Hotel101 in Kokapet, Hyderabad, India. This expansion marks a significant milestone in the company's global growth strategy, bringing its novel, globally standardized “condotel” business model to one of India’s fastest-growing technology and business hubs.

The joint venture partner for Hotel101-Hyderabad is Pooja Crafted Homes (“PCH”), a Hyderabad-based developer founded in 2001 that has developed residential and commercial projects totaling more than 5.5 million square feet. Introduced and facilitated by CBRE India, the partnership pairs PCH’s local development experience with Hotel101 Global’s platform. PCH is also developing one of Hyderabad’s first luxury mixed-use developments that may include a JW Marriott-branded hotel and branded residences.

Hotel101 Global Team believes it ensures all its projects via direct developments, joint ventures and licensing to local developers in various countries worldwide are in prime and strategic locations.

Hotel101-Hyderabad is planned to occupy the top 7 floors of The Harvest Building, a premium Grade-A commercial development in Kokapet. This strategic high-rise positioning is expected to offer guests breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding landscape, including Kokapet Lake and the vibrant western corridor skyline. Kokapet has rapidly emerged as one of Hyderabad’s premier luxury and investment destinations, known for its modern infrastructure, upscale developments, and seamless blend of residential, commercial, and recreational spaces.

Key Location Advantages:

  • Prime Western Corridor Position: Located in Kokapet, directly adjacent to the Financial District and just minutes from Gachibowli and HITEC City. Upon completion, guests are expected to benefit from excellent connectivity via the Outer Ring Road (“ORR”), upcoming metro expansions, and proximity to major IT hubs housing global companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Infosys.
  • Proximity to Business and Employment Hubs: Ideal for business travelers and corporate guests, with immediate access to Hyderabad’s booming Financial District, IT parks, and commercial centers. Hotel101 Global believes the area’s strong job market and high demand for quality accommodation drive consistent occupancy potential.
  • Lifestyle and Leisure Appeal: Surrounded by modern amenities including premium malls (such as Kokapet One), restaurants, green spaces, and natural attractions like Khajaguda Hills. The location is expected to offer the balance of urban convenience and serene surroundings, providing leisure travelers with easy access to Hyderabad’s renowned heritage sites, including Charminar and Golconda Fort, along with its dynamic cultural attractions.
  • Investment and Growth Potential: Kokapet is one of Hyderabad’s most active real estate markets, benefiting from gated communities, world-class infrastructure, high rental demand, and strong appreciation driven by IT sector growth and premium developments.

When completed, Hotel101-Hyderabad is expected to have a project value of approx. ₹5.95 billion (US$64.4 million) and is expected to be the largest hotel by room count in Hyderabad, India, forming part of Hotel101 Global’s global expansion strategy.

Hotel101-Hyderabad is expected to offer 4-star amenities at affordable prices, featuring breathtaking views from its elevated floors, swimming pools, all-day dining, a modern fitness center, function rooms, a business center, a convenience store, and approx. 625 signature HappyRooms. Consistent with Hotel101’s offerings across its locations globally, guests are expected to enjoy modern, tech-enabled rooms, 24/7 reception, and a range of lifestyle amenities tailored for both business and leisure travelers.

The development forms part of Hotel101 Global’s global expansion strategy through joint ventures with local partners and is subject to customary governmental, regulatory, corporate and other approvals.

About Hotel101 Global

Listed on Nasdaq (Ticker: HBNB) with a market capitalization of approx. US$1 billion as of November 26, 2026, Hotel101 is an asset-light, prop-tech hospitality platform pioneering a globally standardized “condotel” business model. Hotel101 aims to disrupt the global hotel and hospitality sector through its unique tech-enabled business model that positions it to generate revenues twice: first from the advance sale of individual hotel units during the construction phase; and second, from long-term recurring revenue derived from day-to-day hotel operations. The expansion of Hotel101 toward its long-term goal to operate in 100 countries globally is expected to be driven mainly by joint ventures and, in the future, license agreements with local developers in various countries worldwide.

The Hotel101 Global Group is advancing its global expansion plans toward its medium-term goal to be in 25 countries and its long-term goal of operating one million Hotel101 rooms in 100 countries globally.

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / EON Resources Inc. (NYSE American:EONR) ("EON" or the "Company") is an independent upstream energy company with 20,000 leasehold acres in the Permian Basin with approximately 1.2 billion barrels of original oil in place. Today, the Company announced that it reported a theft of property from the oil field to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force (the "NMOTTF") that led to arrests of several suspects.

On Saturday, November 21, 2026, at approximately 3:00 am, three suspects wearing dark masks, in a blue pickup, were caught on security cameras at the Grayburg-Jackson oil field in Eddy County, New Mexico owned and operated by LH Operating, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of EON. The suspects cut and stole copper wire critical to some of the field's operations.

"Each of the perpetrators were wearing masks, but the Company had good surveillance video including video of the pickup truck involved. All video and photographs were turned over to the SE New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force," said Dante Caravaggio, CEO of EON. EON also posted the same photographs on social media hoping someone would recognize and help identify the pickup and individuals. A Good Samaritan reported individuals and a vehicle matching the description from the surveillance footage. With the volunteered information turned over to the NMOTTF, the NMOTTF arrived at a residence where a truck was located fitting the description of the truck used in the theft and arrests were made.

According to authorities, a significant amount of copper wire was identified at the residence. The copper wire had been stripped of its insulation.

The NMOTTF moved quickly to identify alleged participants within two days of the theft. Limited production in the field was partially interrupted for 3 days until new wire could be procured and installed on a fast-track basis.

"We are thrilled to have reported the theft directly to the New Mexico Oilfield Theft Task Force who were incredible. We hope cameras and quick action, as was the case this time, help all operators bring down costs, downtime, and losses from criminal activity that hurts everyone," stated Dante Caravaggio.

About EON Resources Inc.

EON is an independent upstream energy company focused on maximizing total returns to shareholders through the development of onshore oil and natural gas properties. EON's Class A Common Stock trades on the NYSE American under "EONR," and its public warrants trade under "EONR WS." For more information on the Company, please visit the EON website.

Two Permian Basin Assets, Multiple Development Horizons

Grayburg-Jackson Field (GJF): 13,700 contiguous leasehold acres in Eddy County, New Mexico, with stacked pay zones and almost 1 billion barrels of estimated original oil in place, of which less than 7% has been produced to date. The San Andres horizontal development program commenced in August 2026.

South Justis Unit (SJU): 5,360 contiguous acres in Lea County, New Mexico, with approximately 207 million barrels of original oil in place. EON's geologic and reservoir work on the Blinebry zone indicates development potential that management believes is similar in character to the opportunity identified in the GJF.

VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Integra Resources Corp. ("Integra" or the "Company") (TSXV: ITR) (NYSE American: ITRG) is pleased to announce the publication of its 6th annual Sustainability Report (the "Report") covering the producing Florida Canyon Mine ("Florida Canyon") and the DeLamar Project ("DeLamar") and Nevada North Project ("Nevada North") (together, the "Development Projects"). The Report highlights the Company's first full year as owner and operator of Florida Canyon in northern Nevada and, at DeLamar, the signing of a historic Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation. The Report aligns with the International Financial Reporting Standards ("IFRS") Sustainability Accounting Standards Board ("SASB") Metals and Mining Standard and covers Integra's activities and performance from January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025.

Environmental, Social, and Governance ("ESG") Highlights:

  • Environmental:
    • Achieved zero reportable spills at Florida Canyon and the Company's Development Projects.
    • Maintained strong water management performance, with no exceedances of water discharge permit limits.
    • Enhanced baselines for stream and wetland mitigation work by surveying approximately 122 acres of wetlands and approximately 116,000 feet of streams at DeLamar.
    • Partnered with Trout Unlimited to explore a potential U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Good Samaritan remediation project for abandoned mine sites in the Jordan Creek watershed, outside DeLamar.
    • Continued support of the Jordan Valley Rangeland Fire Protection Association ("RFPA") and worked in collaboration to combat the threat of rangeland wildfires.
  • Social:
    • Signed the Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation.
    • Integrated all Integra employees into a combined benefits and retirement program.
    • Contributed more than US$400,000 to local communities through donations, sponsorships and in-kind support.
    • Supported over 23,400 people through community programs and strategic investments.
    • Connected with more than 14,500 individuals through meaningful outreach and stakeholder engagement efforts.
    • Incurred one lost-time injury and seven reportable injuries.
    • Implemented a hazard recognition program at Florida Canyon as a leading safety indicator, with more than 300 hazards reported and rectified in December 2025 alone, demonstrating strong workforce adoption.
  • Operations:
    • Advanced a major Florida Canyon fleet expansion, commissioning a Hitachi EX3600 shovel, a CAT 992HL wheel loader, and two new CAT 785 haul trucks in 2025, with six additional CAT 785 haul trucks added to the mining fleet in 2026.
  • Governance:
    • In 2025, 20% of corporate objectives were ESG-linked, and 90% of those objectives were met.

George Salamis, President, CEO and Director of Integra commented: "2025 was a defining year for Integra. In our first full year operating Florida Canyon, we began to establish a mining operation built on our values, investing in the people, equipment and systems needed to sustain the mine in the years ahead.  At DeLamar, years of meaningful engagement culminated in a Relationship Agreement with the Shoshone-Paiute Tribes of the Duck Valley Reservation, a milestone we are particularly proud of. Together, these achievements reflect our commitment to responsible mining and building lasting relationships with the communities where we operate. As we continue towards our goal of becoming a mid-tier precious metals producer, we remain committed to accountability, environmental stewardship and the well-being of our people and communities."

Integra is a growing precious metals producer in the Great Basin of the Western United States. Integra is focused on demonstrating profitability and operational excellence at its principal operating asset, the Florida Canyon Mine, located in Nevada. In addition, Integra is committed to advancing its flagship development-stage heap leach projects: the past producing DeLamar Project located in southwestern Idaho and the Nevada North Project located in western Nevada. TAICHUNG, Taiwan, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd (NASDAQ: AGCC) ("Agencia" or the "Company") today provided an update on its AI computing and data center business and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance with the applicable laws and regulations governing its business. The Company also clarified certain matters referred to in a media report published on November 25, 2026 (the "Report"). The Report does not allege that the Company has breached any law or regulation.

Expanding From Whisky Into AI Computing Infrastructure and Data Center Operations

Agencia listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market in October 2025 as an importer and distributor of whisky, a business that it continues to operate. In reviewing opportunities for growth beyond whisky, the Board of Directors identified strong demand for AI computing capacity and data centers in Southeast Asia, a region in which the Company and its management have established business relationships. Southeast Asia has attracted substantial data center investment from international operators, supported by the availability of land and power at competitive cost. The Company believes that this market offers long-term growth opportunities.

To develop that opportunity, the Board appointed Mr. Li Qiang as Chairman on December 11, 2025. Mr. Li has more than 20 years of experience in the data center and technology infrastructure industry, and he oversees the development of the Company's data center business.

Since announcing its AI computing strategy in February 2026, Agencia has been developing its data center and AI computing business and, directly or through its subsidiaries, has entered into a number of agreements for that purpose, as disclosed in its reports filed with or furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The Company expects to begin providing AI computing services once the computing capacity it has contracted from its provider is in place, subject to and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Like other companies listed in the United States, Agencia aims to build long-term value for its shareholders, and it will continue to evaluate opportunities that can do so within applicable laws and regulations.

Commitment to Compliance

Agencia is committed to conducting its business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the export control laws and regulations of the United States. The Company has not sold or supplied any product or service to any party in breach of the export control laws of the United States or of any other jurisdiction, and it has no intention of doing so.

Under the Company's computing capacity agreement, the provider warrants that the equipment used to provide the services is sourced through authorized sales channels and is exported and imported in compliance with applicable export control laws.

On November 19, 2026, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Department of Commerce ("BIS") published an interim final rule on remote access to advanced semiconductors. The rule introduces new requirements that may apply to the Company's computing capacity and customer arrangements. Those requirements, and the steps that manufacturers and suppliers are taking in response to them, may affect those arrangements, including their timing. The Company is reviewing the rule, and its supplier and customer arrangements, with its advisers. It is committed to complying with all applicable rules and regulations and will provide services only as they permit.

Clarification Regarding Recent Media Report

The Company wishes to clarify two matters referred to in the Report.

The Company's business. The Company is not a seller or reseller of semiconductor chips or hardware. Agencia's data center business is a services business comprising two service lines: data center colocation services, which will provide space, power and connectivity for customers’ own equipment, and AI computing services, in which the Company contracts for computing capacity to provide AI computing cloud services to its customers. No AI semiconductors, hardware or servers are, or are planned to be, sold, delivered or transferred to any customer in either service line.

Relevant entities highlighted in the Report. The Report describes Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings Limited ("Yuxing InfoTech") as the parent company of Ricloud AI Inc. ("Ricloud AI"). The document that the Report cites for that statement, the 2025 annual report of Yuxing InfoTech, lists Ricloud Corp. as a subsidiary of Yuxing InfoTech. It does not list Ricloud AI as a subsidiary. Ricloud Corp. and Ricloud AI are separate legal entities.

The Company's related party relationships and transactions are disclosed in its filings with the SEC, including its prospectus filed on July 20, 2026. Mr. Li's positions with Yuxing InfoTech and with Ricloud AI are described in that prospectus.

"Agencia began as a small whisky business, and we are building a second business in data center and AI computing infrastructure because we see a real opportunity to create value for our shareholders," said Mr. LIU Shihao, Chief Financial Officer of Agencia. "Our focus is on disciplined execution and on building this business transparently and in compliance with the laws of the United States and of every country in which we operate." 

About Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd

Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd is a Nasdaq-listed company with two principal business focuses: (i) its established premium whisky operations; and (ii) the development of data center and AI computing infrastructure, including data center colocation services and cloud-based AI computing services.

Since early 2026, the Company has launched and been developing its AI Computing Infrastructure Initiative, covering data center colocation and AI cloud computing services through subsidiaries in Singapore, Indonesia and other jurisdictions. This initiative represents a principal business focus, backed by substantive contractual arrangements for commercial AI computing cloud services and the development of supporting data center, power, network and technical infrastructure. The Company’s historical operating revenue has been derived from its whisky operations, and the data center and AI computing business remain in development and deployment and is subject to significant business, financing, construction, technology, regulatory, customer demand and execution risks.

TOKYO, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aurora Mobile Limited (NASDAQ: JG) ("Aurora Mobile" or the "Company"), a leading provider of customer engagement and marketing technology services, opened its "AI in Action: Bringing AI to Enterprise" global roadshow in Tokyo on November 24, hosting a closed-door summit for enterprise technology leaders from across Japan. The event marked the first stop of the Company's 2026 international series.


The adoption paradox
AI agents can now handle complex, cross-system tasks that were out of reach a year ago. Yet capability has not translated into business outcomes. In his opening keynote, Mr. Weidong Luo, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Aurora Mobile, described what he called the "AI adoption paradox": 44% of enterprises are expanding their AI deployments, but only 6% report meaningful business returns, while more than 40% of agent projects stall, regress or are cancelled.

The obstacle, he argued, is not model intelligence but the absence of infrastructure that lets AI act safely. He put the question to the room directly: if AI could complete half a day of work on its own, would you give it write access to your CRM or ERP?

Moving from fixed workflows to autonomous agents, Mr. Luo said, depends less on how capable the model is than on how prepared the enterprise is: "Your agents are only as ready as your enterprise."

He set out three principles for enterprise AI readiness:

  • Make systems callable — connect business systems through APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so agents can read and act, not merely converse;
  • Make know-how reusable — turn proven business methods into shared, callable "skills" the whole team can use;
  • Govern every action — layer approval workflows and audit logs over every tool and skill an agent can reach.


GWork: GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace
At the summit, Aurora Mobile introduced GWork, GPTBots.ai’s Enterprise AI Workspace. Designed to bring AI into employees’ everyday work, GWork connects to the tools and company systems they already use, helping them conduct research, analyze data, and create reports, documents, and presentations. IT teams can centrally manage access, usage, and security.

Deployments in the field
The program also featured customers describing how AI is being applied in their own operations, across real estate, contact center services and systems integration:

VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Inturai Ventures Corp. (the "Company") (CSE: URAI) (OTC: URAIF) (FSE: 3QG0) is pleased to announce that its spatial intelligence platform now works floor by floor in multi-level buildings. The Company's sensors can tell which floor of a building a person or device is on, and report only what is happening on that floor. The new capability, Precision Floor-Level Wireless Intelligence, is available now and is designed for customers operating sites on more than one level.

The release follows the Company's go-live at the first outlet of a Southeast Asian Pizza Hut operator, announced on November 17, 2026. Live commercial and pilot deployments are now running. Since that announcement, the Company has been building new leads with household name retailers and aged care providers. These discussions are at an early stage, and there is no assurance they will lead to agreements. Floor-level sensing supports those deployments and unlocks parts of the pipeline where sites run across more than one floor. It can be applied beyond retail and aged care, and the Company expects it to support commercialisation in the other markets it serves.

Wireless signals pass through floors and ceilings, so a sensor on one floor can pick up a phone on the floor above and treat it as if it were on the same level. In a multi-storey store, care facility or office, that puts visitor counts, alerts and equipment locations on the wrong floor. The Company's sensors now learn each building on their own and ignore anything from the floors above and below. The capability is switched on remotely on sensors already installed, with no site survey and no new equipment.

The capability was developed in-house and builds on the Company's proprietary sensing methods and the intellectual property framework it announced in February 2026. Conventional approaches to floor-level accuracy rely on manual site surveys or specialised hardware, and the Company's innovative approach needs neither. The Company is considering patent protection for the capability, and there is no assurance that a patent will be filed or granted.

Retailers get visitor numbers they can rely on for each level of a store. Aged care providers know which floor an alert has come from, so carers go to the right place first. Businesses tracking tagged equipment can see which floor each item is on. It can also reduce cost for customers who would otherwise need a separate system for each floor.

In the Company's testing in multi-floor buildings, the capability accurately detected the correct floor. Performance varies with building type, conditions and device type. Organisations can contact Inturai to switch on floor-level sensing at their existing sites, and further updates will be provided as material developments occur.

The Rights Plan is consistent with shareholder rights plans adopted by other Canadian public companies and is intended to promote the fair treatment of all shareholders in the event of a take-over bid and to protect against "creeping bids," which may result in the accumulation of 20% or more of the Company's common shares outside the formal take-over bid process. The Rights Plan has not been implemented in response to any specific proposal to acquire control of the Company and the Board is not aware of any pending or threatened take-over bid for the Company.

Pursuant to the Rights Plan, one right was issued and attached to each common share of the Company outstanding as of the effective time of the Rights Plan. A right will also be attached to each common share issued after the Effective Date in accordance with the terms of the Rights Plan. The issuance of the rights will not change the manner in which shareholders trade their common shares of Metalla and the rights will automatically attach to the common shares with no further action by shareholders being required. Subject to the terms of the Rights Plan, the rights become exercisable in the event that any person (including associates and affiliates and persons acting in concert) becomes a beneficial holder of 20% or more of Metalla's outstanding common shares, without complying with the "Permitted Bid" provisions under the Rights Plan. Cupertino, California--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Boardwalktech Software Corp (TSXV: BWLK) (OTCQB: BWLKF) ("Boardwalk" or the "Company") the leading provider of patented digital-ledger and AI-enabled Enterprise Software Solutions for Intelligent Information Management, is pleased to report its financial results for the six-months ended September 30, 2026 ("H1-FY27"). Financial Highlights for the six-months ended September 30, 2026 ("H1-FY27"):

  • The Company defines annual recurring revenue ("ARR") as the recurring revenue expected based on annual license subscriptions and recurring services. ARR is a non-IFRS measure. ARR at September 30, 2026 was $3.25 million

The improvement over the September 2025 period is due to lower operating expenses, primarily SG&A expenses and depreciation, partly offset by lower gross margin dollars on lower revenue.

  • Total selling, general and administration ("SG&A") expenses in H1-FY27 totaled $2.1 million, a $0.5 million decrease from $2.6 million reported in the September 2025 period due to the Company's continued cost-savings efforts.

  • As of September 30, 2026, Boardwalk had $122 thousand of cash plus $1.1 million of collectible receivables which have been fully collected subsequent to the end of the period. During H1-FY27, the Company closed non-brokered private placement gross proceeds of C$1,500,000 on April 27 and C$874,500 on September 24.

  • Outstanding debt as at September 30, 2026, was $2.2 million, compared to $2.5 million at March 31, 2026, which was drawn against the previously announced $4 million line of credit from Celtic Bank. The Boardwalktech Verity product received ServiceNow certification that the Company is now a ServiceNow Build Partner. The integration extends ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) with Boardwalktech's automated execution and testing of business and financial controls, helping customers reduce manual work and maintain evidence of control effectiveness.

Management Commentary

"Our focus coming into Fiscal 2027 was to turn the investments we have made in our technology and partner relationships into commercial success," said Andrew T. Duncan, Chief Executive Officer of Boardwalktech. "Although the timing of new customer commitments has been slower than we would have liked, we are encouraged by the conversations we are having with prospective customers and the level of engagement from ServiceNow and IBM. Integrating Verity into ServiceNow's platform and working alongside IBM to bring our solution to market are significant steps forward for Boardwalktech. Both relationships give us the ability to pursue opportunities on a scale that would have been difficult to achieve on our own. We have done much of the heavy lifting on product development and restructuring our cost base. Our priority now is closing business, growing recurring revenue and demonstrating the operating leverage we have built into the business. We believe we are closer than ever to realizing the commercial potential of our technology."

Outlook

Boardwalktech enters the second half of Fiscal 2027 having largely completed its transition from an enterprise information management company into an Intelligent Information AI Platform company. Built on the Company's patented Digital Ledger technology, Velocity, Verity and Unity Central address increasingly important enterprise requirements around trusted data, controls automation, regulatory compliance and AI-enabled workflows.

A key focus for the remainder of Fiscal 2027 is commercial execution, particularly through the Company's relationships with ServiceNow and IBM. The integration of Verity with ServiceNow IRM enables financial institutions to automate controls testing and evidence collection within their existing ServiceNow workflows, reducing barriers to adoption and opening a significant new distribution opportunity. Concurrently, Boardwalktech continues to work with IBM to develop a joint go-to-market strategy for Verity. Management believes these relationships have the potential to materially accelerate customer adoption and scale the business without a corresponding increase in its direct sales infrastructure.

The economic value proposition for Verity remains compelling. In one large financial institution use case, automating manual controls testing could deliver projected annual operating savings exceeding US$20 million. As banks and other large enterprises look to reduce operating costs while meeting increasingly complex regulatory requirements, management believes Verity is well positioned to capture a portion of this spending.

Beyond Verity, the Company continues to pursue opportunities to expand Velocity deployments, commercialize Unity Central and cross-sell its AI-enabled products into its existing base of more than 15 Fortune 500 customers.

Although enterprise sales cycles have been longer than anticipated, management remains encouraged by the quality and breadth of the opportunities under development. With much of the product development investment and cost reduction initiatives behind it, the Company's focus is increasingly on converting its pipeline into recurring revenue.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that its tirzepatide and GLP3 transdermal patches have each passed formal U.S. testing and that it has ordered 20,000 units of each from its exclusive U.S. manufacturer. They are the third and fourth patches in the Company's needle-free line to reach a commercial production order, following BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1, and the Company is targeting a full needle-free lineup on sale by the first quarter of 2027, up from the single patch on sale today.

The tirzepatide patch was announced as under development on August 19, 2026 and entered formal U.S. testing on October 13, 2026. The GLP3 patch entered development on October 20, 2026. Both are in the Company's metabolic and weight-management category, and both have now passed the same U.S. testing stage that the Company's BPC-157 and Thymosin Alpha-1 ("TA1") patches passed before their own production orders.

100% Tested and Manufactured in the United States

Every patch in the line follows the same production and testing process: formulated in the United States, tested in the United States by an independent laboratory, produced in the United States, then released. The first patch through that process, The Recovery Patch (BPC-157), recorded 95.5% chromatographic purity and a quantified 2.02 mg dose per patch in independent laboratory testing, exceeding the 95% threshold widely used as the benchmark for high-purity peptide products.

TA1 followed with a 20,000-unit order at 2 mg per patch. Tirzepatide and GLP3 have now cleared the same stage. All four formulations are produced by one U.S. manufacturer solely for the Company under the exclusive manufacturing rights announced on October 22, 2026, so that one testing standard and one production standard apply across the whole line.

No Needle, No Mixing, No Refrigeration

Injectable peptides, including the Company's own prescription vials, are typically supplied as a powder that must be mixed with sterile water, measured into a syringe, injected and kept refrigerated. We are targeting commercial availability of all four patches by March 2027, with MOTS-c now also in development as our fifth. Our priority is clear: accelerate commercialization, expand our product portfolio and establish The Precision Peptide Company as a leader in needle-free peptide delivery."

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Railtown AI Technologies Inc. (CSE: RAIL) (OTCQB: RLAIF) ("Railtown" or the "Company") today announced new on-demand model evaluation capabilities that use data captured from actual agent runs to compare alternative AI models. The technology extends Railtown's agent observability capabilities and helps developers and enterprises assess whether a lower-cost model or a different deployment environment can meet an application's quality and reliability requirements.

Evaluating Models Against Real Application Workloads

Railtown's agent observability technology can run locally or through its Conductr cloud platform, giving developers visibility into agent execution across development and production environments. The new capabilities use historical execution data to evaluate alternative models against real application workloads.

Developers can use these evaluations to identify tasks that may run on smaller, more efficient models, assess whether suitable workloads can move to a device or privately controlled infrastructure, and reduce reliance on any one provider. As new models become available, teams can revisit model choices throughout an application's life.

Evaluating Models in Apple's AI Ecosystem

Combining the new evaluation capabilities with Railtown's open-source Railtracks Swift Agent Development Kit (ADK) and agent observability gives Apple developers a way to assess which workloads could run on Apple's on-device foundation models or on a model running on Apple's Private Cloud Compute, where available.

Moving suitable tasks to an on-device model can reduce external inference costs, keep those model requests on the device and enable offline functionality where supported. Eligible developers can also evaluate Apple's cloud-hosted model for tasks that need more reasoning capacity or a larger context window.

"Developers should be able to look at the work their agents already do and ask where a smaller model can deliver the quality they need," said Marwan Haddad, CTO and Co-Founder of Railtown AI. "For an Apple developer, that might mean moving part of a workflow onto the device. For an enterprise, it might mean running a model on infrastructure it controls. In both cases, the decision starts with data from the application itself."

Supporting Private and Sovereign AI Deployments

Enterprises and governments seeking greater control over sensitive data and intellectual property can use the technology to assess whether open-weight models running on infrastructure they control meet the requirements of existing applications.

In Canada, Railtown sees an opportunity to complement investment in sovereign AI infrastructure by helping organizations identify which workloads can move to domestically controlled computing environments and what changes those workloads may require.

The new capabilities extend Railtown's agent development tools, which include the open-source Railtracks Swift and Python ADKs, knowledge retrieval technology, agent observability and the Conductr platform. The Company is also exploring ways to build on its observability and evaluation technology to help developers optimize prompts and agent workflows.

Railtown expects to make the evaluation capabilities available to developers soon and plans to publish a technical blog demonstrating how to use them.

Its technology includes Conductr, an agentic AI orchestration, deployment and observability platform; Railengine, its knowledge and data infrastructure; and Railtracks, its open-source Agent Development Kit.

Brisbane, Australia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Graphene Manufacturing Group Ltd. (TSXV: GMG) (OTCQX: GMGMF) ("GMG" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director Craig Nicol will participate in a live fireside chat hosted by Cory Fleck of the KE Report. The event will take place on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. PT (Vancouver) / 7:00 p.m. ET / Wednesday, December 2, at 10:00 a.m. AEST (Brisbane).

Craig Nicol will discuss the latest G®CELLS fast-charging results, first sample shipments to potential customers and plans to manufacture larger-format cells in the UK. He will also cover new exclusive distribution agreements with Brenntag Química S.A.U., initially covering Spain, Italy and Portugal, and with GrafnoMex in Mexico for G® LUBRICANT. The discussion will also include an update on quality progress at GMG's Gen 2.0 graphene plant. Attendees can submit questions throughout the live discussion.

Register for the live event: https://event.webinarjam.com/gykm4/register/xp0x6fmr

Topics expected to be discussed include:

  • Fast-charging battery results (October 8): Testing at the Battery Innovation Center of Indiana showed an energy density of 58 Wh/kg with six-minute charging, up 48% from 39 Wh/kg. GMG also reported 94% energy efficiency and, in a separate cycling test, no measurable performance loss after 1,000 cycles.
  • First G®CELLS customer samples (October 21): GMG began shipping 1.5 Ah pouch cells designed for six-minute charging to potential customers for evaluation, including in the defence and heavy mobile equipment sectors.
  • European distribution agreement (November 4): GMG signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Brenntag Química S.A.U. covering Spain, Italy and Portugal initially. Brenntag will focus first on G® LUBRICANT through its existing lubricant distribution network while developing opportunities for G® FLUID and THERMAL-XR®.
  • G® LUBRICANT distribution in Mexico (November 12): GMG named GrafnoMex its exclusive distributor in Mexico for G® LUBRICANT, a graphene engine oil additive. GrafnoMex reported lower fuel consumption and emissions in local tests on heavy-duty diesel trucks.
  • UK battery manufacturing (November 19): GMG signed an initial service agreement with the UK Battery Industrialisation Centre to manufacture larger-format G®CELLS in Coventry using battery materials produced at GMG's development centre in Brisbane.
  • Gen 2.0 graphene plant quality progress (November 25): GMG made crucial quality progress at the new, higher production rate of its Gen 2.0 graphene manufacturing plant, which is expected to produce 10 tonnes of graphene per annum once fully completed and optimised.

About GMG

GMG is an Australian based clean-technology company which develops, makes and sells energy saving and energy storage solutions, enabled by graphene manufactured via in house production process. GMG uses its own proprietary production process to decompose natural gas (i.e. methane) into its natural elements, carbon (as graphene), hydrogen and some residual hydrocarbon gases. This process produces high quality, low cost, scalable, 'tuneable' and low/no contaminant graphene suitable for use in clean-technology and other applications.

The Company's present focus is to de-risk and develop commercial scale-up capabilities, and secure market applications. In the energy savings segment, GMG has initially focused on graphene enhanced heating, ventilation and air conditioning ("HVAC-R") coating (or energy-saving coating) which is now being marketed into other applications including electronic heat sinks, industrial process plants and data centres. Another product GMG has developed is the graphene lubricant additive focused on saving liquid fuels initially for diesel engines.

In the energy storage segment, GMG and the University of Queensland are working collaboratively with financial support from the Australian Government to progress R&D and commercialisation of GMG Graphene Batteries. GMG has also developed a graphene additive slurry that is aimed at improving the performance of lithium-ion batteries.

GMG's 4 critical business objectives are:

  • Produce Graphene and improve/scale cell production processes
  • Build Revenue from Energy Savings Products
  • Develop Next-Generation Battery
  • Develop Supply Chain, Partners & Project Execution Capability
